race.comment: SPIRITS BURN DEEP (9) looks to find her race today and due for a change of luck. Stalked the speed and wasn't that far away when fourth over 1200m at Grafton. Gets in light again and expected to go close. JUSTBETRYIN' (11) racing in career best form and on the ten-day back-up after finishing a respectable third over 1200m at Wagga. Gets map favours and races well at this track. BRUTAL EYES (5) showed good early muster first up with the 61kg when a narrow third over 1210m at Moruya. Goes equally as well second up and can overcome the sticky gate. MAGNARDO (3) comes up from Victoria and now in the Becky Byrne yard. Has a tidy record on the Synthetic tracks and can make an immediate impact here. LANG PARK (6) mixing his form of late and worth thought after the run at Warren three starts back.
